title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
abstract: arXiv:2609.37529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subseque

translated_title: 面向逆问题的有原则的MAP估计：弥合收敛性与性能之间的差距
translated_abstract: 预训练去噪器为将图像先验融入图像恢复算法提供了一种强大的途径。即插即用和RED方法在一阶优化框架中使用固定噪声水平的去噪器，具有收敛性保证，但在严重不适定的逆问题上往往难以实现高质量的重建。相比之下，最近的最先进方法利用源自基于流或扩散生成模型的去噪器，并在一系列递减的噪声水平上对其进行评估。尽管这些方法取得了出色的实证性能，但其收敛理论仍然有限。本文通过专门设计一种算法来弥合这一差距，该算法将递减噪声水平的去噪器与为确保收敛而量身定制的调度方案相结合。从贝叶斯视角出发，我们证明了在适当的假设条件下，我们的方法收敛于最大后验（MAP）估计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将递减噪声水平的去噪器与确保收敛的调度方案相结合的新算法，并从贝叶斯视角证明了该方法在适当假设下收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计，从而弥合了图像恢复方法中收敛理论与实证性能之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a tailored schedule to ensure convergence, and proves from a Bayesian perspective that it converges to a Maximum a Posteriori (MAP) estimate under suitable assumptions, bridging the gap between convergence theory and empirical performance in image restoration.
